name: Veggie Burger Lettuce Wrap with Special Sauce, Blue Cheese & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the mushrooms are cooking, place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in another small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp ketchup
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are done, add additional vinegar and cook until dry, 15-30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, season burger patties with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 veggie burger patties, plant-based
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add burger patties and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and cooked through, 8-10 minutes (or cook patties according to package instructions). Add to the plate with the mushrooms and re-cover with foil.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp white wine vinegar
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside two leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add the bite-sized pieces to the bowl with the dressing; toss to coat.
Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, on each plate; top with special sauce, burgers, mushrooms, blue cheese, and pickled onions. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
